description: This file contains unit tests for the IncorrectAttributeUseAnalyzer, a Roslyn diagnostic analyzer designed to identify improper use of serialization attributes on Grain classes in an Orleans-based project. The tests verify that the analyzer correctly flags or ignores classes based on their inheritance and attributes, ensuring proper application of serialization attributes in different scenarios.

classes.name: IncorrectAttributeUseAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of the IncorrectAttributeUseAnalyzer, which checks for incorrect serialization attribute usage on Orleans grain classes.

methods.name: VerifyHasDiagnostic
methods.description: Helper method that verifies the code sample triggers a diagnostic from the analyzer, indicating incorrect attribute usage.

methods.name: VerifyHasNoDiagnostic
methods.description: Helper method that verifies the code sample does not trigger any diagnostic from the analyzer.
